1.t: He frowned and turned ˹his attention˺ away

2.t: ˹simply˺ because the blind man came to him ˹interrupting˺

3.t: You never know ˹O Prophet˺, perhaps he may be purified

4.t: or he may be mindful, benefitting from the reminder

5.t: As for the one who was indifferent

7.t: even though you are not to blame if he would not be purified

8.t: But as for the one who came to you, eager ˹to learn˺

11.t: But no! This ˹revelation˺ is truly a reminder

12.t: So let whoever wills be mindful of it

13.t: It is ˹written˺ on pages held in honour—

17.t: Condemned are ˹disbelieving˺ humans! How ungrateful they are ˹to Allah˺

18.t: From what substance did He create them

19.t: He created them from a sperm-drop, and ordained their development

20.t: Then He makes the way easy for them

21.t: then causes them to die and be buried

22.t: Then when He wills, He will resurrect them

23.t: But no! They have failed to comply with what He ordered

24.t: Let people then consider their food

25.t: how We pour down rain in abundance

26.t: and meticulously split the earth open ˹for sprouts˺

27.t: causing grain to grow in it

28.t: as well as grapes and greens

32.t: all as ˹a means of˺ sustenance for you and your animals

33.t: Then, when the Deafening Blast comes to pass—

34.t: on that Day every person will flee from their own siblings

37.t: For then everyone will have enough concern of their own
37.tr: Likul limri-im minhum yawmaa-izin shaa-nuy yughneeh

38.t: On that Day ˹some˺ faces will be bright

42.t: those are the disbelievers, the ˹wicked˺ sinners
